info.name: StudentHub API
info.description: Run the folders top to bottom. Register (or Login) stores the access token; the refresh token is kept by Postman's cookie jar. In the backend .env set COOKIE_SECURE=false for http://localhost.

request.description: Sets the XSRF-TOKEN cookie needed by /auth/refresh and /auth/logout.
201. A second run returns 409 (email taken): use Login instead.
With MAIL_ENABLED=false the reset link is printed in the backend console.
400 if the token is invalid, expired or already used.
